description: Fixed descriptions for audible singing in a pop arrangement. Frozen before scoring; not a test of intelligibility or musical quality.

positive.text: A melodic pop song with a sung vocal melody, piano chords, strings, bass guitar and a steady drum kit.
A singer performs a pop melody over a rhythmic band accompaniment.

contrast.text: An instrumental pop tune with a synthesizer lead melody, piano chords, strings, bass guitar and a steady drum kit.
An instrumental pop melody played by a synthesizer over a rhythmic band accompaniment, without singing.
